notes: I changed the counter rule: ACTION5 now advances the counter when it actually toggles a block (E16 s3, E18 s2, E9 s2, E10 s2, E12 s2 all show a counter move on a real A5 change), while still not advancing when A5 does nothing (E14 s1, E16 s1/s2, E18 s1/s3). The old "A5 never advances" rule was contradicted by those experiments.
